```yaml
name: Database Export

on:
  schedule:
    # Run every Sunday at 02:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 2 * * 0'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  export-database:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      packages: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Export and sanitize SQLite database
        env:
          DB_PATH: ./data/database.sqlite
          SANITIZED_DB: ./dist/sanitized.db
        run: |
          # Ensure the database file exists
          if [ ! -f "$DB_PATH" ]; then
            echo "Database file not found at $DB_PATH"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Create a temporary directory for the dump
          mkdir -p ./tmp
          # Dump the database to SQL
          sqlite3 "$DB_PATH" ".dump" > ./tmp/dump.sql

          # Sanitize: remove rows from sensitive tables (example: users, payments)
          # Adjust the table names and conditions as needed
          sed -i '/^INSERT INTO "users"/d' ./tmp/dump.sql
          sed -i '/^INSERT INTO "payments"/d' ./tmp/dump.sql

          # Recreate the sanitized database
          sqlite3 "$SANITIZED_DB" < ./tmp/dump.sql

          echo "Sanitized database created at $SANITIZED_DB"

      - name: Compress sanitized database
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          zip -j dist/sanitized-db.zip dist/sanitized.db
          echo "Compressed database to dist/sanitized-db.zip"

      - name: Upload database artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: sanitized-database
          path: dist/sanitized-db.zip
          retention-days: 30
```
